extName.message: CookieMop — Auto Delete Cookies on Tab Close

extDesc.message: Automatically deletes cookies & site data when you close a tab. Keep only the sites you trust. Local, open-source, no tracking.

popupCleanConfirm.message: This site is whitelisted — delete anyway?

popupCleanAllSub.message: Whitelist and open sites are kept

popupReviewAsk.message: Enjoying CookieMop? A ★ review helps a lot

optionsSubtitle.message: Auto delete cookies on tab close — 100% local, open source

optionsDelayDesc.message: Wait after a tab closes before cleaning — a safety net for accidentally closed tabs.

scopeAllDesc.message: Also clears IndexedDB, CacheStorage and Service Workers

rulesEmpty.message: No rules yet — add a domain below or from the popup.

greylistHint.message: Greylist sites are cleaned when the browser closes — note this also runs when the extension itself is reloaded or updated.

importDesc.message: Coming from Cookie AutoDelete? Import its exported expression list (JSON) — whitelist and greylist entries are converted automatically.

importError.message: Could not read that file — export your expressions from Cookie AutoDelete as JSON and try again.

profilesDesc.message: Keep separate rules for work and personal browsing, and switch between them with one click.

profilesPlaceholder.message: Name this rule set… e.g. Work

profilesBenefit.message: Rule profiles are part of Pro — keep one rule set for work and another for personal browsing, and switch with one click.

keepDesc.message: Clean a site as usual, but hold on to the one cookie that keeps you logged in. Cookie names come from your browser's developer tools.

keepBenefit.message: Per-cookie keeping is part of Pro — clean a site on every tab close while the cookie that holds your login survives.

proPitch.message: The core of CookieMop is free forever. Pro adds power-user extras — one payment, no subscription.

proFeatureProfiles.message: Rule profiles — separate rules for work and personal browsing, switched with one click

proFeatureCookieWhitelist.message: Per-cookie whitelist — clean a site but keep the one cookie that keeps you logged in

proPriceNote.message: once — we have no servers, so we don't charge you monthly.

proLocalNote.message: Your license is verified on this device. CookieMop still makes zero network requests, even with Pro.

proHaveKey.message: Already bought it? Paste your license key

proErrorInvalid.message: That key isn't valid. Check you copied all of it from the email.

proErrorUnsupported.message: This browser can't verify licenses. Please update Chrome and try again.
